items.content_html: RailwayAI is a computer vision research project for 2D-to-3D railway component identification and visual defect detection. It uses DINOv3, SigLIP, and C-RADIOv4 to compare image embeddings against a procedurally generated library of 500 3D components, with FAISS-based similarity retrieval and open-set recognition.
